assumptions: Penny, nickel, dime, quarter, and $ are interpreted as conventional U.S. currency terms.

The 48 cents left over is the post-trip remainder of the change saved in the jar.
f3_program: collection("family.jar.coins", "coin", "family.counter.jar", source("A jar on the family's counter contains change"))
observe(at("family.jar.coins.penny.count", "initial"), 123, "count", source("123 pennies"))
observe(at("family.jar.coins.nickel.count", "initial"), 85, "count", source("85 nickels"))
observe(at("family.jar.coins.dime.count", "initial"), 35, "count", source("35 dimes"))
member("family.jar.coins", "family.jar.coins.quarter", source("a number of quarters"))
observe(at("family.trip.double_scoop.count", "trip"), 5, "count", source("All five family members get a double scoop"))
observe(at("ice_cream_shop.double_scoop.unit_price", "trip"), 3, "usd_per_double_scoop", source("costs $3 each"))

product_relation("family.trip.ice_cream.total_cost", at("family.trip.double_scoop.count", "trip"), at("ice_cream_shop.double_scoop.unit_price", "trip"), source("All five family members get a double scoop, which costs $3 each"))

consume("e1", "family", at("family.jar.change.value", "current"), "family.trip.ice_cream.total_cost", source("All five family members get a double scoop, which costs $3 each. After the trip, they have 48 cents left over"))
observe(at("family.jar.change.value", "after_trip"), 48, "cent", source("After the trip, they have 48 cents left over"))
query("value", at("family.jar.coins.quarter.count", "initial"))
